general.descriptionTextModule: View statistics about processed messages in the message queue system
general.emptyStateSubline: No message queue statistics have been collected yet.
general.bannerDescription:
This page provides insights into how Shopware message queues are performing by displaying statistics from processed messages. Each time a message is processed, the system records how long the message stayed in the queue. Statistics are calculated based on a sliding window configured in system settings.

Key statistics shown:
 • Total messages processed: How many messages have been successfully processed within the time window.
 • Average time in queue: The average time (in seconds) messages spend waiting in the queue before processing. This helps you spot delays or bottlenecks.
 • Processing window: Shows the time of the oldest message currently included in the statistics. For example, if your statistics window is set to 1 hour but processing started just 5 minutes ago, it will reflect this shorter duration.
 • Message Types: A breakdown of the different types of messages processed, including how many of each type were processed. This helps you identify if certain types of messages are overwhelming the queue.
